title: Receivables Desk Note — Pet Addendum Balance, Payments and Charge Reversals
content:
**The pet balance.** What a leaseholder owes on a Pet Addendum is its pet balance: the pet fees, pet rent and pet fines posted to the addendum, less the credits and payments posted to it. Credits are of two kinds — the additional-pet discount on pet rent, and the reversal of a charge posted in error.

**Rules**

- **P1.** Pet payments are accepted while the addendum is active or ended. The status is read from the company's record of the addendum the payment is for.
- **P2.** A payment is applied to the oldest open pet charge first.
- **P3.** Application of the security deposit toward the pet balance is used only at final accounting.
- **P4.** A charge reversal credits a pet charge posted under the Pet Addendum, once per charge.

A payment is recorded with the amount received, the date received, the instrument used and its confirmation or instrument number.

**Payment acceptance by addendum status**

| Addendum status | Pet payment accepted |
|---|---|
| Pending approval | No |
| Denied | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Ended | Yes |

**Allocation illustration (hypothetical ledger)**

A hypothetical Pet Addendum carries three open charges: a pet fee of 300.00 posted in January, pet rent of 40.00 posted in February and pet rent of 40.00 posted in March. A payment of 320.00 is received.

| Open charge, oldest first | Open before | Applied | Open after |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pet fee, January | 300.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 |
| Pet rent, February | 40.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| Pet rent, March | 40.00 | 0.00 | 40.00 |

The payment settles the oldest charge in full and 20.00 of the next oldest; the March line remains open in full.

**Points of judgement**

- *A charge has already been credited by a charge reversal. Can a second charge reversal be posted against the same charge?* No. P4 allows a charge reversal once per charge.
- *Can the security deposit be applied to the pet balance outside final accounting?* No. P3 uses application of the security deposit toward the pet balance only at final accounting.
- *Is a payment accepted after the addendum has ended?* Yes. P1 accepts pet payments while the addendum is active or ended.
